name: Ollama
description: Run local models with native Ollama chat, model lifecycle, embeddings, and an optional normalized driver.
install:
kujo run /path/to/kennel/kennel.kujo --interpreter -- add github:kujolang/ollama@v0.1.11 --alias ollama
kujo run /path/to/kennel/kennel.kujo --interpreter -- install

kujo run /path/to/kennel/kennel.kujo --interpreter -- install

name: OpenAI
description: Use OpenAI's Responses API with native output items, tools, reasoning, embeddings, and normalized chat.
install:
kujo run /path/to/kennel/kennel.kujo --interpreter -- add github:kujolang/openai@v0.1.2 --alias openai
kujo run /path/to/kennel/kennel.kujo --interpreter -- install
code:
from openai import create_client, client_responses

client := create_client({})
request := {
    "model": "gpt-5.5",
    "input": "Hello from Kujo!"
}

result := client_responses(client, request)

print(result["data"]["output"][0]["content"][0]["text"])
